title: Machine Learning Algorithm Accurately Predicts Mental Health Crises
content:
Koa Health, in collaboration with Birmingham and Solihull Mental Health NHS Foundation Trust, developed a machine learning algorithm capable of accurately predicting mental health crises before they occur.

The study

The research analysed anonymised data collected over seven years from patients within the NHS Trust. The algorithm was trained to identify patterns in this data that precede a mental health crisis — giving clinicians an early warning window to intervene proactively.

Results

  • The algorithm correctly predicted more than half of crises 28 days in advance
  • This early prediction proved clinically valuable in 64% of cases
  • Described as a first of its kind in the UK

Why it matters

Mental health crises are often preceded by subtle signals that are difficult for any individual clinician to detect in time. By surfacing these patterns at scale, this algorithm could fundamentally shift the model from reactive crisis response to proactive, preventative care — reducing harm and improving outcomes for some of the most vulnerable patients in the NHS.
